title: Retarget right-now PR to develop and release to main
description:
As a Kanbus maintainer, I want PR 195 merged to develop and then main with a semantic-release feat commit, so the right-now summary ships in a new version.

## Definition of Done

- PR 195 base is develop, not dev.
- At least one conventional commit of type feat is on the branch so python-semantic-release bumps the version when main CI succeeds.
- The branch is merged to develop.
- develop is merged to main so the Semantic Release workflow can tag a new 0.x version.
right_now_summary: PR 195 needs to target develop, then merge to main with a feat commit for release.
